title: Choice of Collateral Currency in Differential Swaps
abstract: arXiv:2603.07863v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: The role of collateral in derivative pricing has evolved beyond credit risk mitigation, particularly following the global financial crisis, when funding costs and basis spreads became central to valuation practices. This development coincided with the transition from the London Interbank Offered Rate (LIBOR) to risk-free rates (RFRs) and the increasing standardization of collateralised trading. We study the valuation and hedging of a class of differential swaps referencing backward-looking averages of overnight rates, with Secured Overnight Financing Rate (SOFR) swaps appearing as a particular instance. The focus is on the impact of the collateral currency. Extending the earlier results of Bickersteth et al. [Math. Finance 36 (2026), pp.~180--202], we allow the collateral account to be denominated in a currency different from that of the contractual cash flows and derive explicit pricing and hedging strategies using a futures-based r

translated_title: 差额互换中抵押货币的选择
translated_abstract: 抵押品在衍生品定价中的作用已超越了信用风险缓释的范畴，特别是在全球金融危机之后，融资成本和基差利差成为估值实践的核心。这一发展与伦敦银行间同业拆借利率（LIBOR）向无风险利率（RFR）的过渡以及抵押化交易的日益标准化同时发生。我们研究了一类参考隔夜利率后视平均值的差额互换（differential swaps）的估值与对冲问题，其中以担保隔夜融资利率（SOFR）互换作为特例。研究重点是抵押货币的影响。通过扩展Bickersteth等人[Math. Finance 36 (2026), pp. 180--202]的早期结果，我们允许抵押账户以与合约现金流不同的货币计价，并利用基于期货的方法推导出显式的定价与对冲策略。
tldr: 本文研究了一类参考隔夜利率后视平均值的差额互换的估值与对冲，将抵押账户扩展为可用不同于合约现金流的货币计价，并给出了显式的定价与对冲策略。
en_tdlr: This paper extends the valuation and hedging of differential swaps referencing backward-looking overnight rate averages by allowing the collateral account to be denominated in a currency different from the contractual cash flows, deriving explicit pricing and hedging strategies.
